questions.question:
Nine friends A to I sit in three rows of three seats, all facing north. The front row is the northernmost row. Left means west. The following facts are known:
1. A sits in the front row at the east end.
2. F sits immediately to the left of A.
3. B sits in the middle row at the centre.
4. D sits directly behind A.
5. H sits immediately to the left of B.
6. G sits directly behind D.
7. I sits directly behind B.
8. E sits in the back row at the west end.

Who sits in the front row at the east end?
questions.explanation: The rows (front to back) are C F A / H B D / E I G, so A sits there.
